title: Burger King Foot Lettuce
blurb: An entire generation can recite this passage from memory and none of them can explain why. The famously flat narration is a real human: YouTuber Chills, whose monotone gets mistaken for text-to-speech, reading it in "Top 15 Mysteries Solved by 4Chan", describing a genuine 2012 incident in which a Burger King employee photographed himself standing in a tray of lettuce. The flat synthetic delivery of an increasingly grim sentence is what made it immortal. The voice has no idea it is being funny. Play it when a story takes a turn nobody was ready for, or to trigger recitation in anyone within earshot.
origin: Narrated by YouTuber Chills in the video 'Top 15 Mysteries Solved by 4Chan' (2017).
